opening.argument: The presentation is framed as a practical Mac tutorial for blocking pop-up scams, as its title asks, "How to block pop-up scams on a Mac computer?" The visible Safari controls focus on security protections, including fraudulent-site warnings and blocking pop-up windows, while the Privacy preferences address website tracking and cookies. The workflow also includes a local TextEdit step described as, "Create HTML file to delay malicious websites load." These steps are directed toward blocking or mitigating malicious websites, not soliciting participation in them. No payment request, credential request, investment offer, or promoted deceptive transaction is shown, leaving the content as an educational technology and operational demonstration rather than a deceptive transaction.

citations.quote: How to block pop-up scams on a Mac computer?
